s.h: Salary up to £65,000 DOE plus Welcome Bonus up to £5,000!
s.t:
At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.
Wilton House Veterinary Clinic is looking for an experienced Small Animal Veterinary Surgeon to join our friendly and highly collaborative team in a senior clinical capacity. This is an exciting opportunity for a confident clinician looking to take the next step in their career, combining a varied and rewarding caseload with the opportunity to support and mentor less experienced colleagues, while remaining focused on clinical practice rather than management responsibilities.
You'll be joining a supportive team that genuinely values collaboration, continuity of care, and high clinical standards. Working alongside certificate holders in Cardiology, Small Animal Surgery and Small Animal Medicine, you'll have the opportunity to discuss cases, continue developing your own clinical interests, and help support and mentor our new graduate and less experienced colleagues.
Our caseload is diverse and engaging, with patients including cats, dogs, rabbits, small furries, occasional exotic species and backyard chickens. We encourage our vets to work cases up thoroughly and provide the clinical freedom to pursue areas of interest, whether that's surgery, medicine, dentistry, ECC or another passion.

You'll enjoy a rewarding mix of consultations and surgery, with exposure to everything from routine procedures through to advanced dentistry, orthopaedic surgery and emergency presentations.
Practice Highlights

s.h: Senior clinical role with no management responsibilities
s.t:
Work alongside certificate holders in Cardiology, Small Animal Surgery and Small Animal Medicine
Diverse first-opinion caseload including cats, dogs, rabbits, small furries, exotics and occasional poultry
Excellent balance of consulting, surgery, inpatient care and case continuity
Exposure to advanced dentistry, orthopaedics and emergency and critical care cases
Modern facilities including a dedicated theatre, separate prep area, digital radiography, dental x-ray and a new ultrasound scanner
Separate cat ward, isolation facilities and excellent staff amenities
Part of a supportive three-practice network alongside our Stokesley and Copeland clinics, offering additional clinical support and expertise
Dedicated Practice Director supporting all three sites, with access to experienced Clinical Directors across the wider group
Friendly, highly experienced nursing and client care team with a strong culture of teamwork and knowledge sharing
How You'll Make a Difference
As a Senior Veterinary Surgeon, you'll play a key role in delivering exceptional patient care while supporting the development of the wider clinical team.
Alongside managing a varied first-opinion caseload, you'll act as an experienced clinical presence within the practice, helping to support recent graduates and less experienced colleagues through mentoring, case discussion and collaborative working.

Deliver high-quality medical and surgical care across a varied first-opinion caseload
Manage and work up medical and surgical cases to a high clinical standard
Perform routine and more advanced surgical procedures where appropriate
Build strong client relationships through excellent communication and continuity of care
Support and mentor new graduate and early-career Veterinary Surgeons
Contribute to clinical discussions and continuous improvement in patient care
Work closely with the veterinary, nursing and client care teams to deliver outstanding patient outcomes
Help foster a positive, supportive and collaborative clinical culture
Working Pattern
Full-time position
40 hours across four days
Shared Saturday rota
Flexible working discussions welcomed
Life in Guisborough
Located on the edge of the stunning North York Moors, Guisborough offers the perfect blend of countryside, coastline, and community living. With beautiful walking routes, easy access to the Yorkshire coast, and excellent transport links into Middlesbrough, York, and Newcastle, the area provides a fantastic quality of life both in and out of work.
The practice enjoys a strong local reputation and loyal client base, creating the opportunity to build lasting relationships with clients while enjoying the benefits of working within a close-knit and supportive community.
You Might Be a Great Fit If...
You are an experienced and confident veterinary surgeon who enjoys mentoring others, working cases up to a high standard, and contributing positively to team culture. You'll bring:
* A Veterinary degree and registration (or eligibility to register) with the RCVS
* Solid experience within small animal first-opinion practice
* Confidence in routine surgery, medicine, and clinical decision-making
* Strong communication skills and the ability to build lasting client relationships
* A collaborative approach and willingness to support and develop colleagues
* A proactive attitude towards clinical development and continuous improvement
* A passion for delivering exceptional patient and client care
How We’ll Support You
We’re committed to supporting your ongoing development and wellbeing. When you join us, you’ll benefit from:
* Clear career pathways with progression opportunities across primary care, referral, leadership, and specialist roles
* Funded learning and development including CPD allowance and access to IVC academy training centres & role-relevant courses
* £1,250 annual Care Fund for every vet
* Access to mentors, regional clinical coaches, and peer networks
* Support to develop clinical interests and expand your capabilities
* A collaborative, values-led culture focused on care, community, and continuous improvement

* 6.6 weeks’ holiday including bank holidays
* Private medical insurance
* Enhanced family leave and pay across maternity, paternity, adoption and surrogacy
* BVA membership, VDS cover & RCVS fees
* Cycle to Work and Green Car schemes (eligibility applies)
* Retail discounts and cashback offers
* Reduced-cost veterinary care for your own pets
We’re committed to supporting our people through career development opportunities, wellbeing initiatives and access to world-class learning resources.
Whether you’re just starting out or looking to take the next step in your career, inspiring vet care offers the support, opportunity and community to help you grow.

We are seeking an experienced and driven Senior Equine Veterinary Surgeon to join our progressive, client-focused practice. This is an exciting leadership opportunity for a confident clinician looking to shape and develop a thriving equine service while working within a supportive and collaborative team. If you're already a Senior, we would also welcome Lead Vets.
You will play a central role in delivering high standards of veterinary care, building strong client relationships, and leading a talented team of equine professionals. The caseload is varied and rewarding, spanning leisure, sport, and performance horses.

Our purpose-built equine clinic includes examination rooms, stables, a knockdown box, and paddocks. We are well-equipped with x-ray, ultrasound, endoscopy, gastroscopy, shock wave therapy, and dentistry services. Our in-house lab at the small animal clinic enables us to get quick results for urgent cases.
How You’ll Make a Difference
As Senior Veterinary Surgeon, you will be responsible for leading clinical standards, governance, and the delivery of outstanding patient and client care.
You’ll provide clinical leadership to the veterinary team, oversee complex cases, and act as the primary source of clinical guidance and decision-making within the practice. Working closely with the senior practice leadership team, you’ll support the strategic direction of the practice and drive continuous improvement in clinical quality, outcomes, and ways of working.
The role is Monday to Friday between the hours 8am and 5pm, contributing to the on call rota. 1 in 4 weekends on call with days off in lieu for this.

· Deliver exceptional clinical care across a varied equine caseload
· Provide clinical leadership and mentorship to the equine team
· Drive the development and expansion of equine services
· Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with clients
· Contribute to clinical governance, protocols, and continuous improvement
· Work collaboratively with the wider practice leadership team
· Participate in a shared out-of-hours and weekend rota

You are a highly experienced veterinary surgeon with strong clinical expertise and a passion for leadership and clinical excellence. You’ll bring:
* A Veterinary degree and registration with the RCVS with significant equine veterinary experience, confident in both routine and emergency equine work
* Proven experience in mentoring, coaching, and supporting veterinary colleagues
* Strong leadership, communication, and decision-making skills
* Experience contributing to or leading clinical governance, audits, and quality improvement initiatives
* The ability to manage clinical complaints and provide professional guidance in complex situations
* Professionalism, integrity, and a commitment to the highest standards of patient and client care

In addition to the above qualifications, candidates who possess the following qualifications will be considered "Highly Preferred" or "Best Qualified": Possess active United States Department of Agriculture/ Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (USDA/APHIS) accreditation.

Physical Requirement: Ability to lift 45 lbs and long periods of standing, restraining, kneeling, reaching and sitting, etc. Must have use of fingers; Both hand and both legs are required; Position requires exposure to intermittent excessive noise. The information provided on your resume should be clear and specific.

You will be rated based solely off of the information provided within your resume. Assumptions will not be made regarding your experience and the duties performed.
